summary: Eco Wave Power filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about California's SB 605 report that references the company's Port of Los Angeles pilot project. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer, providing an update on regulatory recognition and project progress. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The press release does not contain any terms of a deal, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. This is an ordinary update on commercial development and policy advancement.
